topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, would you ever! Turns out the chap I've been knowing through these new-fangled letters from across the wide world actually tills the soil not far from here. A coincidence, they say, is a small miracle sent down by the saints. I reckon I'd best go fetch a basket of the finest apples we've been growing. After all, it's not often you find a neighbor who's also a friend from afar. The Gods do smile kindly on us sometimes, don’t they? I'll wander over to his plot, sharing tales of the weather and the ways of the soil, just as if we’d always known each other. Perhaps we shall find more in common than just the earth beneath our feet.
